verdict.rationale: Logseq markets itself as 'privacy-first, open-source' (logseq-docs-23) but no documentation describes an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, and a community source directly disputes the privacy claim, noting 'a very vague privacy policy with more tracking and analytics than I would have expected for something that claims to be Privacy-First' (logseq-comm-20). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a telemetry toggle/opt-out setting, first-party privacy policy details, and independent confirmation that tracking can actually be disabled.
